keel-read.description: Read and search projectRoot only. Literal inspect Shell commands are allowed; writes and external paths are denied.

keel-explore.description: Read and search anywhere on the filesystem. Literal inspect Shell commands are allowed; writes are limited to the /tmp/pi-work/ scratch area.

keel-plan.description: Read anywhere; write docs/, CONTEXT.md, and /tmp/pi-work/. Inspect Shell commands are allowed, modify and unknown commands require approval, and execute commands are denied.

keel-develop.description: Read anywhere and write project files freely; modify, execute, and unknown Shell commands still require approval.

keel-build.description: Read and write project files and /tmp freely; home config writes require approval; known modify and execute commands are allowed, unknown commands require approval, and destroy commands are denied.

keel-subagent-project.description: Sub-agent tier T1: read anywhere; write project/** and /tmp/pi-work/. Inspect Shell commands only.
